appearance.show_notification_icon_dot: Show new activity in the background notification

save_instance_prints_to_file.description: Save spawned prints to your content folder

save_instance_stickers_to_file.description: Save placed stickers to your content folder

save_instance_emoji_to_file.description: Save spawned emoji to your content folder

launch_command.title: Request from another app
launch_command.switchavatar: Another app asked VRCX to change your VRChat avatar to {avatar}.
launch_command.addavatardb: Another app asked VRCX to add {url} as an avatar search provider. Your avatar searches would be sent to that address.
launch_command.favorite_world: Another app asked VRCX to add the world {id} to your local favorites group "{group}".
launch_command.favorite_avatar: Another app asked VRCX to add the avatar {id} to your local favorites group "{group}".
launch_command.import_avatar: Another app asked VRCX to open the avatar favorites import with a list it provides.
launch_command.import_world: Another app asked VRCX to open the world favorites import with a list it provides.
launch_command.import_friend: Another app asked VRCX to open the friend favorites import with a list it provides.
launch_command.warning: Only allow this if you started it yourself.
launch_command.invalid: VRCX ignored a request from another app that it doesn't understand.

system.boot_description: Starts VRCX in the background after the device restarts, so notifications and the PC companion keep working without opening the app.
system.boot_needs_background: Turn on Keep running in background to use this.

custom_files.import_description: Import custom.css and custom.js from your device. Only add scripts you trust: custom JS can do anything VRCX can, including reading your saved logins.
custom_files.css_file_description: A style sheet that changes how VRCX looks. It applies right away.
custom_files.js_file_description: A script that runs every time VRCX starts.
custom_files.js_imported: Imported {name} as custom.js. Reload VRCX to run it.
custom_files.js_removed: custom.js removed. Reload VRCX to stop it.
custom_files.js_confirm_description: custom.js runs inside VRCX with the same access as the app, including your saved logins and your VRChat session. Only import a script you wrote yourself or fully trust.
